newsitem.title: THAILAND: Stallone, Willis to open Planet Hollywood Bangkok.
newsitem.headline: Stallone, Willis to open Planet Hollywood Bangkok.

text.p: Film stars Sylvester Stallone and Bruce Willis will open Planet Hollywood restaurant in Bangkok on January 24, the company said on Friday.
The two stars, both shareholders in the multi-million dollar Hollywood-themed restaurant group, will fly in from Singapore after opening the group's 39th restaurant there on January 22.
Other shareholders in the company include stars Arnold Schwarzenegger and Demi Moore.
Willis, who starred in the films "Pulp Fiction", "Twelve Monkeys" and the "Die Hard" series, will entertain guests by singing with his own rock band.
Some 200 movie props and assorted film memorabilia, including a red Austin mini car featured in the film "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and a shield from "Ben Hur", adorn the Bangkok outlet.
Planet Hollywood held an initial public offering last April.
